pred_text: Èle èèna ka, dhèu Masir aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne manganga titu kèna. Nèti èèna ka, Yusuf bhoke eele d'ara èmu na, ho pahia dhèu rai Masir. Lod'o èèna, dhèu Masir aa'i-aa'i ètu rai Masir abhu manganga titu kèna.

source_text: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
target_text: Lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu Yusuf ètu rai Masir.

source_text: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, Why do you look at one another?
target_text: Tèu èèna, Yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu Masir. Ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, Ana ee! Miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?
pred_text: Lod'o èèna, baki Yakob ladhe nèdhi, na, ètu rai Masir abhu nganga'a. Nèti èèna ka, na karèi ana na, aku nèngu na, Nga tao ka miu se patigi èci dènge èci?

source_text: He said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.
target_text: Ja'a tadèngi na ètu Masir pahia nganga'a. Hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.
pred_text: Hèia na peka, Sèmi ne'e! Ja'a tadèngi, na, ètu rai Masir abhu nganga'a-nganginu. De lamu hèli ètu nèi, sèna ka hèli nganga'a hia èdhi. Te èdhi hud'i mamuri ku, te èdhi madhe boe.

source_text: Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
target_text: Ka a'a Yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa Masir.

source_text: But Jacob didn't send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, with his brothers, for he said, Lest perhaps harm happen to him.
target_text: Te ngaa Yakob hia boe ari Yusuf dhu ngara na Benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. Te, na pangee, Mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

source_text: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph's brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.
target_text: Tèu èèna, Yusuf j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae Masir. Ladhe dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli are, Yusuf ka dhu pahia. Nèti èèna ka, lod'o a'a na si d'ai nèi, rèngu patitu kètu urutuu, ho tab'e Yusuf toke rèhu rèngu oe d'ai rai.
pred_text: Lod'o èèna, Yusuf j'aj'i gubernur ètu rai èèna. Nèngu ka dhu pahia rai ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai èèna. Ka ari na mai paraga dènge ne, hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, ka ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha nèngu.

source_text: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, Where did you come from? They said, From the land of Canaan, to buy food. Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn't recognize him.
target_text: Ropa Yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'a na si, na tadhe le èèna. Te ngaa Yusuf tao iisi sèmi dhèu Masir. Nèti èèna ka, rèngu tadhe boe ne hèi. Hèia na jèka si, aku nèngu na, Ee! Miu se nèti mia? Hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, Ji'i se nèti Kana'an. Ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa ama wakil.
pred_text: Ropa Yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'ari na, ka na tadhe si. Te ngaa na tadhe boe si. Ka na karèi si dènge lii sakaa, aku nèngu na, Miu se, dhèu mia ka mai? Hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, Ji'i mai nèti rai Kana'an, ho hèli nganga'a. Ka Yusuf tadhe a'ari na, te ngaa dhèu se tadhe boe ne.

source_text: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.
target_text: Hèia Yusuf sanèd'e lii nii na uru na. Ka na pamadha'u si, aku nèngu na, Ja'a lèka boe! Miu se'e dhèu mata-mata. Miu mai tenge rahasia rai Masir, ho èèna na mai musu rai ji'i!
pred_text: Ropa tadèngi nare, hèia Yusuf sanèd'e nii dhu na nii lula-nèti rèngu dua ra. Ka na peka, Miu se dhèu mata-mata! Miu mai ho neo paraga dènge dhèu ae ètu rai èèna, lula rèngu dènge boe mèdha-papake.

source_text: They said to him, No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.
target_text: Te ngaa ra dhaa peka na, Aad'o, ama! Ji'i se'e dhoka ana pua-paleha nèti ama di. Tare'a-re'a ji'i mai sa ne'e ne, neo hèli nganga'a di. Leo nèti èèna, aad'o.
pred_text: Te ngaa dhèu se dhaa, peka na, Aad'o, ama. Ji'i dhèu sab'a ama se, mai sèna ka hèli nganga'a.

source_text: We are all one man's sons, we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.
target_text: Ji'i aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana nèti ca ama di. Ji'i mai mata-mata boe rai ama ku si ne'e. Ji'i se'e dhèu be'a.

source_text: He said to them, No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!

source_text: They said, We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.
target_text: Ka ra peka, Aad'o ama! Ji'i se'e ana pua-paleha ama ku di. Ji'i mai nèti rai Kana'an. Ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ca ama, canguru dua dhèu. Ari ji'i dhu limuri tèka, pea dènge ama ji'i. Aa ari ji'i èci aad'o heka!

source_text: Joseph said to them, It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies! '
target_text: Hèia Yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, Aad'o! Lèke sèmi lii ja'a deo na! Miu se'e dhèu mata-mata.
pred_text: Te ngaa Yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, Tare'a! Ja'a dhu peka mema le, na, Miu se dhèu mata-mata! '

source_text: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.
target_text: Na! Karèi sèmi èèna, na miu hia ku tadha èci, sèna ka ja'a ke'a lii padhai lii miu deo sa, tare'a, do aad'o. Ja'a subha ee! Ladhe ari miu dhu limuri na, d'ai boe ne'e, miu èci sa bisa boe kalua nèti rai ne'e!
pred_text: Ja'a neo tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka miu me'a, na, Lamatua sèmi nare boe miu dènge be'a. Te ngaa ja'a neo tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka miu me'a, na, Lamatua sèmi nare miu dènge be'a. Lula dhèu aae Masir mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, nèti èèna ka miu bisa boe tèke eele ne, ladhe ari miu dhu haha mai boe.

source_text: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.
target_text: De hua iia miu pua dhèu èci la'e, ho nèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna asa ne'e mai. Aa miu dhu leo se, ja'a taha. Ja'a neo ke'a miu se'e peka tare'a, do aad'o. Ladhe aad'o, miu se'e tare'a-re'a mata-mata.

Te dhèu aae Masir dhu ne'a le, na, miu se dhèu mata-mata di. De ji'i manèngi sèna ka miu pua dhèu lasi paroa ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae Masir.

source_text: He put them all together into custody for three days.
target_text: Ka Yusuf pua taha si d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.
pred_text: Èle èèna ka, komedhaa j'aga èèna pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.

source_text: Joseph said to them the third day, Do this, and live, for I fear God.
target_text: D'ai lod'o ka tèlu, Yusuf la'e padhai lii dènge ra ètu d'ara bèdho, peka na, Ja'a ne'e, ca dhèu dhu madha'u dènge Lamatua. Aa ja'a madhutu dad'èi Na taruu. Sèna ka miu mamuri, ja'a neo patabuli miu. Te ngaa hud'i dènge ku lii pajaji.
pred_text: Ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, Yusuf dhaa, peka na, Ja'a manèngi makasi mi Ama Lamatua. De miu hud'i tao ku sèmi ne'e, sèna ka miu mamuri taruu.

source_text: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison, but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.
target_text: Ladhe miu se'e tare'a padhai lii dhu mola, miu pad'elo ku ngaa èci j'aj'i mi tadha. J'ara na sèmi ne'e, ja'a taha ca dhèu ètu d'ara bèdho ne'e. Dhèu leo lèpa ho mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, te ra tatae miu lami mèti nganga'a.
pred_text: Ladhe miu dhèu d'ara mola, baku soro tèke dhèu sarani ca dhèu mai asa d'ara bèdho. Te ngaa ladhe sèmi èèna, be'a risi miu mèti nganga'a asa d'ara èmu bèdho.

source_text: Bring your youngest brother to me, so will your words be verified, and you won't die. They did so.
target_text: D'ai nèi, miu mèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna mai asa ne'e, ho j'aj'i bukti, tare'a miu se'e dhèu be'a. Sèna ka ja'a baku huku pamadhe miu. Ropa ra tadèngi rare ne'e, ra d'èi kahèi sèmi èèna.

source_text: They said to one another, We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn't listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.
target_text: Ka ra padhue-padhai ka èci dènge èci, peka na, Waa! Ne'e ne, èdhi heka abhu b'ala kèna, lula sala dhu èdhi ad'u-ue mi dedha ari èdhi uru na. Èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu j'èra titu kèna, d'ai na manèngi sasue èdhi, te ngaa èdhi pusi boe ne. Nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: Reuben answered them, saying, Didn't I tell you, saying, ‘Don't sin against the child, ' and you wouldn't listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.
target_text: Hèia Ruben pasanèd'e si, peka na, We! Ari-ari ja'a, ee! Uru na ja'a kai le miu, ho baku paj'èra ana èèna, si? Te ngaa miu-miu se'e ka dhu mo'o boe nanene lii ja'a. Nèti èèna ka, lod'o ne'e èdhi dui tare raa ari èdhi Yusuf èèna.

source_text: They didn't know that Joseph understood them, for there was an interpreter between them.
target_text: Rèngu padhai lii ae-ae sèmi èèna, re'a boe na Yusuf ne'a lii rèngu kahèi. Lod'o Yusuf padhai lii dènge rèngu, na pake lii Masir, ho èèna na dhèu leo lole hari pake lii Ibrani.

source_text: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
target_text: Tadèngi ra padhai lii sèmi èèna hèia, Yusuf kèd'i eele si, la'e tangi asa era leo. Tangi nare, la'e hari pa'èci dènge si. Ka na pua dhèu èki Simeon ètu madha a'ari na sèra.

source_text: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man's money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.
target_text: Èle èèna ka, Yusuf paredha dhèu sab'a sèra, ho soli are asa d'ara karo a'a na si. Aa tao hari doi kab'ua are sèra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci. Ra tèke ètu hèb'a karo sèra. Na pua dhèu sab'a se'e, ho hia si dènge gee. Ka dhèu sab'a se'e lalau ka, madhutu ngaa dhu Yusuf paredha.
pred_text: Èle èèna ka, Yusuf peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, Lami kalabhe hari doi èci-èci asa d'ara sasusa rèngu. Aa hia hari si nganga'a-nganginu ètu d'ara kakako ra. Yusuf tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.
target_text: Èle ka, a'a na si hua karo nganga'a sèra asa dedha badha keled'ei. Ka ra pakèd'i dènge ka.
pred_text: Hèia dhèu sab'a se pakèd'i, rare nganga'a dènge keled'ei ra, ka ra pakèd'i tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.
target_text: Ropa d'ai talora j'ara, ra ae. Dhèu èci bhoke karo na, ho neo ani keled'ei na. Na ladhe la'a na, doi na ètu dedha are, ètu d'ara karo èèna.

source_text: He said to his brothers, My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack! Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, What is this that God has done to us?
target_text: Capa na cag'ag'a! Hèia na paroa a'a na si, peka na, Irii! Miu mai ladhe ku laa! Madhe èdhi kèna. Ra tao hari doi ja'a asa d'ara karo ne. Ladhe rèdhi èèna ka, ra ele ngangee, aa madha'u bia. Ka ra papeka ka, aku rèngu na, Ama Lamatua tao èdhi samia ka ne?
pred_text: Ropa na tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia na peka dènge angalai na sèra, aku nèngu na, Ira ii! Ja'a b'ae hari le, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a heka b'ae hari kèna! Rèngu madha'u titu kèna, ka ra padhai lii èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, Ira ii! Tasamia ka Ama Lamatua huku èdhi sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,
target_text: Hèia ra kako taruu ka, lasi d'ai Kana'an. D'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, ngaa dhu rèngu paraga ètu rai Masir.

source_text: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father, one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan. '
target_text: Ji'i se'e, dhèu be'a-be'a. Ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi, j'aj'i nèti ca ama, dhèu canguru dua. Te ngaa èci madhe le. Aa ari dhu limuri èèna, dènge ama ji'i ètu Kana'an. '

target_text: Na peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘Ja'a neo kèdhi, na, miu se'e dhèu be'a, do aad'o! Miu èci, pea mi ne'e. Aa leo lèpa mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, sèna ka ra baku madhe manganga.

source_text: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man's bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

source_text: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.

source_text: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
